title: Back on the Wagon
description: Back on the Wagon — The Townstons wiki
html:
Quest Giver: Townston Lieutenant

Quest Type: Kill

Quest Description: Kick out 15 FizzStar-Soaked Whisker Broodlings and 10 FizzStar-Soaked Blademasters from the depths of Algernon. Return to the Townston Lieutenant when you have finished. Wipe your feet first.

Quest Reward: Gold

Return to: Townston Lieutenant

Repeatable: Yes

Zone: Algernon

In-game text

Recovered from the Dungeon Runners client files. The notes above are from the old wiki when they exist.

Journal: Kick out 15 FizzStar-Soaked Whisker Broodlings and 10 FizzStar-Soaked Blademasters from the depths of Algernon. Return to the Townston Lieutenant when you have finished. Wipe your feet first.

Offer:

All of these Whiskers drinking FizzStar is getting out of control. In the seamy underbelly of Algernon, it seems that every Broodling is carrying a can or four of the stuff. You can tell the ones that have had too much from the clouds that surround them. We need to start targeting demand along with the supply. I want you to head on down to the deepest depths of Algernon and start sorting this out. The Whiskers don't have to go home, but they can't stay there.

It's messy work - really messy work - so I am sending you, instead of me. It isn't that I don't like you, its just that I like myself so much more.

Turn-in:

Well, aren't you fragrant! I hope you wiped your feet first.

There are still plenty more of those Whiskers if you want to take another crack at it. Just let me know, though maybe you want to freshen-up first? Please?

Objectives:

  • Bounced Broodlings
  • Bounced Blademasters

Client level range: 10–20
